Frequently Asked Questions
Frequently Asked Questions
Does the Program in Neuroscience offer a Bachelor's or Master's degree?
We currently offer a Ph.D. in Neuroscience and a Minor in Neuroscience.
To learn more about the undergraduate program, visit the NSCS undergraduate program.
We do not offer a Master's degree.
Where do I send my transcripts?
Send all of your transcripts to the Program in Neuroscience. Transcripts must be received in sealed envelopes to be considered official. It is no longer necessary to send additional copies of your transcripts to the Graduate College.
What is the TOEFL code for the department and school?
The TOEFL code for the University of Arizona is 4832; the code for our program is 30.
I took the TOEFL, but my scores will not be received until after December 1st, what should I do?
E-mail Kirsten (kirstencg@arizona.edu) when you expect the scores will be reported to the University of Arizona.
What is the minimum TOEFL/iBT score?
Applicants must submit a minimum TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language) score of 550 paper based (PB), 79 internet based (iBT), or IELTS (International English Language Testing System) composite score of 7 (no subject area below a 6).
What address should I use to send an express mail delivery (FedEx, UPS, etc.)?
Kirsten Cloutier Grabo
Program in Neuroscience
1548 E. Drachman St.
Tucson, AZ 85719
